headline: Natco Pharma Limited: Rights Issue

detail: Rights Issue - Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on September 25, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 21, i.e 2 Equity Shares for every 21 Equity Shares held at an Issue Price of  Rs. 750 per share (including a premium of ₹ 748/- (Rupees Seven Hundred and Forty Eight only) per Rights Equity Share)

sources.name: NSE filing - Natco Pharma Limited
